name: Credit of All Kinds
summary: Private credit beyond single business loans: direct lending portfolios, specialty finance and originator platforms, consumer pools, factoring and receivables, trade finance, equipment finance, litigation and royalty finance, ABS and CLOs, distressed and special situations, CRE note purchases, insurer-affiliated capital, semi-liquid vehicles, bank-like lenders, tokenized credit and NAV lending. The diligence spine: get the loan-level tape and trace it to cash, dedupe the collateral across every facility with a third party holding the documents, test the tape for gaming at eligibility cutoffs and stated income, re-mark collateral, read every financing line's haircut and margin-call terms and stress them with the asset decline, and check the marks against independent and cross-holder prices.
one_check: Independently verify that the loan assets exist, are pledged only to you, and perform as reported (a loan-level tape traced to cash, deduped across every facility, with a third party holding the collateral documents), then stress the lender's own funding: what happens to its warehouse lines and redemptions in the same month its losses peak.

subtypes.name: Direct lending
subtypes.description: Portfolios of private loans to companies; Chapter 3 diligence at portfolio scale.

subtypes.name: Specialty finance / originator platform
subtypes.description: Non-bank originators (auto, SMB, bridge-loan pools) funded by warehouse lines, forward flow and ABS.

subtypes.name: Consumer credit
subtypes.description: Consumer installment, auto, card and residential pools.

subtypes.name: Factoring and receivables
subtypes.description: Purchase of or advance against trade receivables, including supply-chain finance.

subtypes.name: Trade finance
subtypes.description: Financing of goods in transit against shipping documents and letters of credit.

subtypes.name: Equipment finance
subtypes.description: Equipment loan and lease pools with residual risk.

subtypes.name: Litigation finance
subtypes.description: Non-recourse funding of legal claims; see also the litigation finance library.

subtypes.name: Royalty finance
subtypes.description: Music, pharma and mineral royalty streams.

subtypes.name: Asset-backed securities
subtypes.description: Securitized tranches of consumer and commercial receivables.

subtypes.name: CLO
subtypes.description: Collateralized loan obligation tranches, equity, or managers.

subtypes.name: Distressed and special situations
subtypes.description: Stressed or defaulted debt, LME and restructuring plays.

subtypes.name: Note and CRE loan purchases
subtypes.description: Whole loans or pools bought from banks or originators; re-mark and trace.

subtypes.name: Insurer-affiliated private credit
subtypes.description: Platforms whose permanent capital is an affiliated (often PE-owned) life insurer.

subtypes.name: Semi-liquid vehicles as lenders
subtypes.description: Perpetual BDCs, interval funds and other redemption-funded credit vehicles.

subtypes.name: Bank-like lenders
subtypes.description: Banks, credit unions, fintech and specialty lenders funded by deposits or short-term money, and bank counterparties.

subtypes.name: Tokenized private credit and RWAs
subtypes.description: On-chain tokens representing claims on off-chain loans; cross-reference the crypto library.

subtypes.name: NAV lending and fund finance
subtypes.description: Loans against fund NAV; full treatment in the NAV lending library.

intake_questions.question: Which sub-strategy is this: direct lending, specialty finance or originator platform, consumer, factoring, trade finance, equipment, litigation, royalty, ABS, CLO, distressed, note purchase, insurer-affiliated, semi-liquid vehicle, bank-like lender, tokenized credit or NAV lending?
intake_questions.why: Selects the subtype rows from the 4.2 table.

intake_questions.question: Are we buying a pool or tranche, lending to the lender (warehouse, forward flow), co-lending, or investing in the manager's vehicle?
intake_questions.why: Determines whether loan-tape items or vehicle-level items lead.

intake_questions.question: What is the pool or facility size, number of loans, and our exposure?
intake_questions.why: Sizes sampling for payment trace and income verification.

intake_questions.question: How many warehouse lenders, ABS deals, forward-flow buyers or factors does the originator use?
Who holds the original titles and notes today?
Who services, values and reports the assets, and are any of those the manager itself?
How is the lender or vehicle itself funded (warehouse, repo, subscription line, NAV facility, deposits, redemptions, insurer balance sheet)?
intake_questions.why: Funding fragility, semi-liquid, bank-like and insurer items.

intake_questions.question: Is the capital redemption-funded, and what is the redemption cap and gate?
Is the manager's permanent capital an affiliated insurer?
intake_questions.why: Statutory, Schedule S and consolidated RBC items.

intake_questions.question: Does the pool rely on stated income or have eligibility cutoffs (FICO, DTI)?
Is the collateral real estate or consumer secured, and in which states?
Are assets marked Level 3, and who prices them?
Is there a token or on-chain wrapper?

requests.request: Strategy and vehicle description: what the credits are, which vehicle holds them (closed-end fund, perpetual BDC, public BDC, interval fund, SMA, CLO, insurer balance sheet, token), its redemption terms, and a look-through holdings list behind any label such as 'alternative assets', 'direct lending' or 'multi-strategy income'.
requests.format: Offering document extract plus position-level holdings as of the last quarter-end.
requests.why: Labels hide private-loan exposure; a redemption-funded vehicle behaves differently in stress.
requests.pass: Holdings listed at position level and consistent with the label; vehicle and redemption profile identified.
requests.fail: Holdings withheld or inconsistent with the stated strategy.
requests.verify: Compare holdings with administrator or custodian statements obtained directly.

requests.request: Financing stack: every financing line (warehouse, repo, subscription line, NAV facility, asset-based facility, forward flow, total return swap) with lender, limit, drawn balance, haircut or advance rate, margin-call mechanics and triggers, eligibility criteria, and term or renewal date.
requests.format: Schedule signed by the CFO plus each facility agreement.
requests.why: Specialty lenders and levered credit funds fail through their funding before their assets.
requests.pass: Every line listed; margin-call triggers disclosed; renewal dates staggered; schedule reconciles to financial statements and the UCC sweep.
requests.fail: A leverage stack with no disclosed margin-call triggers; lines found later that were not listed.
requests.verify: Confirm each facility with the lender; UCC search on the vehicle and originator. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-020; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Map of who originates, services, values, reports, holds collateral documents and administers cash for the portfolio, naming each third party.
requests.format: Org chart of functions with engagement letters for each third party.
requests.why: A manager that also services, values and reports with no third party controls every number we see.
requests.pass: Independent custodian, administrator or valuation agent, and backup servicer in place, each with a direct engagement.
requests.fail: Manager performs all functions with no third party.
requests.verify: Call each third party to confirm engagement and scope. Generic request also in universal U-FND-009; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Statement of which market-size figure the manager's materials use and its definition and date.
requests.why: Market-size figures differ by definition; averaging them misleads.
requests.pass: Single figure cited with source, definition and date.
requests.fail: Mixed or unsourced figures.

requests.request: Eligibility criteria for each facility and for our investment, with concentration limits and advance rates.
requests.format: Facility definitions and our proposed criteria.
requests.why: Eligibility rules are what originators game (Tricolor altered loan descriptions to meet eligibility).
requests.pass: Criteria objective, testable at loan level, and identical to those tested in the tape; advance rates within norms (factoring 70% to 90% of eligible AR).
requests.fail: Discretionary eligibility; advance rates above norms.
requests.verify: Test eligibility on the tape ourselves.

requests.request: Net yield after losses projection: gross yield, fees, expected loss rate by vintage, overcollateralization and advance rate.
requests.format: Model tab with loss assumptions sourced to static-pool data.
requests.why: Specialty finance lives or dies on loss rates and net yield after losses.
requests.pass: Losses based on static-pool data; positive net yield in the stress loss case (direct lending base 1% a year, stress 2% to 3%).
requests.fail: Losses assumed below the static-pool history.

requests.request: Funding stress model: haircuts stressed to 50% for non-Treasury structured collateral and 100% for esoteric assets, a simultaneous 20% to 30% collateral price fall, facility non-renewal and advance-rate cuts, showing what is sold first, whether forced sales breach covenants elsewhere, and the unencumbered liquidity covering the margin call.
requests.format: Model tab plus a schedule of unencumbered liquid assets with custodian statements.
requests.why: Repo haircuts went from about zero to nearly 50% in 2007-08; some classes became unfinanceable.
requests.pass: Unencumbered liquidity covers the stressed margin call and non-renewal without forced sales that breach other covenants.
requests.fail: Liquidity shortfall in the stress; no unencumbered liquidity.
requests.verify: Confirm unencumbered assets with the custodian. Generic request also in universal U-VAL-023, U-VAL-026; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Liquidity stress scenarios beyond credit losses: HTM and AFS fair-value marks and multiple funding and liquidity scenarios.
requests.why: Stress tests that test only loss rates miss funding runs.
requests.pass: Multiple scenarios run including funding and liquidity; fair-value marks disclosed.
requests.fail: Only a loss-rate stress.

requests.request: Structure and waterfall: tranche attachment and detachment points, underlying collateral, payment waterfall, triggers, and the rating agency's stressed assumptions including correlation.
requests.format: Indenture or offering circular, waterfall model, rating agency presale report.
requests.why: 'Structured' is not one risk class: pre-2008 AAA CDOs lost $325B, AAA CLOs nothing.
requests.pass: Our tranche survives the rating agency's stressed assumptions and our own stress; triggers protect our tranche.
requests.fail: Attachment too thin for collateral quality; rating relies on assumptions we cannot reproduce.
requests.verify: Rebuild the waterfall with our cash-flow model.

requests.request: CLO profile: obligor and industry concentration limits and the AAA break-even default rate at a stated recovery.
requests.why: Obligor (2%) and industry (15%) limits and a ~60% AAA break-even at 40% recovery are what made CLOs resilient.
requests.pass: Obligor limit <= 2% and industry <= 15%; AAA break-even default rate stated at 40% recovery and above the 1931-33 cumulative 31% default rate.
requests.fail: Looser limits; break-even not computed.

requests.request: CLO manager track record: after-fee PME by vintage, management fee as a share of collateral balance, and how much gross outperformance the manager keeps.
requests.why: After fees, CLO outside equity earns about what its systematic risk predicts.
requests.pass: After-fee PME by vintage at or above 1.0 on a risk-matched basis; fee at or near 50 bp of collateral.
requests.fail: Only gross returns shown; fees above norms.

requests.request: Distressed capital structure map: every tranche with amount, lien, guarantors, maturity and holders, the fulcrum security, the bankruptcy process and timeline, DIP availability, and the out-of-court restructuring path.
requests.format: Credit memo with capital structure table and document references.
requests.why: LMEs move value away from non-participants; in a weak DIP market Chapter 11 can mean liquidation.
requests.pass: Fulcrum identified after the worst LME the documents allow (see LME map); DIP availability tested; out-of-court equity-funded path assessed where the DIP market is weak.
requests.fail: Fulcrum priced before LME; recovery at historical averages without haircut.

requests.request: For direct lending: the business-debt covenant-capacity package for each loan (three leverage numbers, maximum permitted leverage under baskets, EBITDA definition, same-sponsor conflicts, holder vehicle).
requests.format: Per-loan memos as specified in the business-debt library.
requests.why: Direct lending diligence is Chapter 3 diligence at portfolio scale.
requests.pass: Package complete for each loan or a statistically meaningful sample in a portfolio purchase.
requests.fail: Package missing for material loans.

requests.request: Litigation finance case model: damages model, collectability of the defendant, and duration with IRR at 1.5x expected duration.
requests.why: Duration and collectability drive litigation returns; control rights can breach ethics rules.
requests.pass: IRR at 1.5x duration above the hurdle; defendant can pay the modelled award.
requests.fail: IRR collapses at 1.5x duration; uncollectable defendant; insufficient capital.
requests.verify: Independent legal opinion and our model.

requests.request: Royalty model: the royalty stream, payor creditworthiness, duration and decline curve, with comparables (for music, Copyright Royalty Board rate determinations and listed royalty funds' NAV write-downs).
requests.why: Royalty value depends on decline curves and payors.
requests.pass: Decline curve fitted to history; payors creditworthy; valuation consistent with comparables.
requests.fail: Flat or rising curves without support.

requests.request: Tokenized credit legal package: the legal right the token conveys (title, beneficial or contractual claim), custodian and bankruptcy remoteness, and the independent audit of the underlying loans.
requests.format: Legal opinion, token terms, custody agreement and audit report.
requests.why: A token is usually a claim on an off-chain asset; trading speed must match the underlying's redemption speed.
requests.pass: Legal right and bankruptcy remoteness confirmed by opinion; underlying loans independently audited.
requests.fail: No opinion; token redeemable faster than underlying assets can pay.
requests.verify: Opinion from our counsel; audit confirmed with the auditor.

requests.request: NAV facility terms: initial and maximum LTV, structural subordination to portfolio-company debt, recallable distributions and cash sweep triggers.
requests.why: NAV loans sit behind every portfolio company's lenders.
requests.pass: Initial LTV 10% to 30%, maximum about 40%; triggers and sweeps defined.
requests.fail: LTV above the norms; no sweep.

requests.request: Semi-liquid vehicle liquidity coverage and flow history: quarterly cash, net investment income and loan maturities against the redemption cap for 12 quarters, redemption requests, amounts met, gating history, whether unmet requests carry forward, and repurchases payable.
requests.format: Offering documents and 12 quarters of flow data.
requests.why: Q2 2026: $7.1B of repurchases against $3.8B of inflows, $10.7B unmet; cash ~5.5%, NII ~2.5% a quarter, maturities < 0.5% against a 5% cap.
requests.pass: Liquidity coverage ratio (cash + NII + maturities) at or above the redemption cap; gating history disclosed; repurchases payable not funding redemptions.
requests.fail: Redemption cap exceeds liquidity coverage; rising leverage or repurchases payable funding redemptions.

requests.request: Insurer-affiliated capital package: statutory statements (not GAAP) of the operating insurer and affiliated reinsurers, Schedule S ceded reinsurance, and RBC recomputed on a consolidated basis including affiliated captives.
requests.format: Statutory filings, RBC computations, policies and valuation reports.
requests.why: Shadow reinsurance cut average RBC by about 53 points when consolidated (about 3 notches); AIG's reinvested collateral needed $37.8B of Fed lending.
requests.pass: Consolidated RBC adequate after including affiliated captives (do the computation ourselves; both the Koijen-Yogo and ACLI positions stand).
requests.fail: Capital adequate only before consolidation; affiliated placements valued by the manager.
requests.verify: NAIC filings and state exam reports pulled by us. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-027; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Bank-like lender funding package: uninsured or flighty share of funding, unrealized securities losses against equity, IRRBB (economic value of equity under rate shocks), an LCR-style 30-day outflow test, collateral pre-positioned at the Fed, and CRE concentration against 300% of capital.
requests.format: Call reports or financials, ALM reports, policy documents.
requests.why: SVB: 94% uninsured deposits and a $17B unrealized loss against $15B equity, visible in filings.
requests.pass: Unrealized losses well below equity; 30-day outflow covered; collateral pre-positioned; CRE below 300% of total capital.
requests.fail: Unrealized loss above equity; outflow uncovered; recent CRO replacement by a dealmaker.
requests.verify: Compute from public filings ourselves. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-026; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Loan-level tape with origination data (FICO, DTI, LTV, income, documentation type, collateral identifiers such as VIN, serial or invoice number) and current status, balance and rate.
requests.format: Excel or CSV with data dictionary, cut from the servicing system as of a stated date.
requests.why: Pool-level summaries hide the loans that matter.
requests.pass: Tape reconciles to the servicer system, trustee reports and the balance sheet within 0.5% of balance.
requests.fail: Summary only; tape does not reconcile.
requests.verify: Loan-tape auditor re-cuts from the system.

requests.request: Payment history by loan traced to bank deposits.
requests.format: Servicer histories and collection account bank statements.
requests.why: First Liberty and the Adam brothers: loans and payments that did not exist.
requests.pass: Payments trace to borrower deposits for a statistically meaningful sample plus all loans above 1% of the pool; no payments from originator or affiliate accounts.
requests.fail: Payments sourced from the originator; missing deposits.
requests.verify: Collection account statements obtained directly from the bank. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-018; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Static-pool data by vintage: delinquency roll rates, charge-offs and recoveries.
requests.format: Monthly vintage tables from the servicing system.
requests.why: 'Few defaults' claims need a delinquency roll.
requests.pass: Complete vintages; consistent with tape; losses in line with the underwriting.
requests.fail: Missing vintages; roll rates inconsistent with charge-offs.

requests.request: Static-pool reconciliation: charge-offs from the servicing system tied to trustee and lender reports.
requests.why: Tricolor booked charged-off loans as current through a fictitious portfolio company.
requests.pass: Zero unexplained differences.
requests.fail: Charged-off loans appearing as current in reports.
requests.verify: Trustee reports obtained from the trustee. Generic request also in universal U-COL-005; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Modification, extension, PIK and forbearance history by loan.
requests.why: Forbearance and stale marks hide losses.
requests.pass: Every modification documented and reflected in status and marks.
requests.fail: Undisclosed modifications; modified loans reported as current without disclosure.
requests.verify: Sample executed documents. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-036; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Servicing agreement, backup servicer agreement and collection-account structure, including who can move cash out of the collection accounts.
requests.why: Servicer failure and commingling in specialty finance.
requests.pass: Named backup servicer tested; segregated collection accounts; dual control on outflows from collection accounts.
requests.fail: No backup servicer; commingled collections; originator controls outflows alone.

requests.request: Custodian receipts for original titles and notes for every pledged loan.
requests.why: Collateral pledged without custodial possession can be pledged twice.
requests.pass: Receipt for 100% of pledged loans.
requests.fail: Originals held by the originator.
requests.verify: Custodian confirms directly. Generic request also in universal U-COL-004; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Every warehouse, forward-flow, ABS and participation agreement the originator has signed, with eligibility criteria for each.
requests.why: Dedupe is impossible without the full list of facilities.
requests.pass: Complete list reconciled to UCC filings and financial statements.
requests.fail: Facilities discovered later.
requests.verify: UCC sweep across originator and affiliates.

requests.request: Item-level collateral dedupe (VIN, invoice or serial number) across all facilities, run by an independent collateral agent or backup servicer.
requests.why: Tricolor: about 40% of roughly 70,000 loans shared VINs or attributes; ~$2.2B pledged against ~$1.4B real collateral.
requests.pass: Zero duplicates across all facilities.
requests.fail: Any duplicate; any facility excluded.
requests.verify: Independent agent obtains files directly. Generic request also in universal U-COL-007; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Cutoff test data: FICO and DTI distributions and default rates around every eligibility cutoff (for example FICO 620).
requests.format: Histogram data from the tape and default rates by bucket.
requests.why: Low-doc loans just above 620 defaulted 10% to 25% more than those just below.
requests.pass: No bunching just above a cutoff and no performance jump at the cutoff.
requests.fail: Bunch or jump at any cutoff.
requests.verify: We plot from the tape. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-017; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Income verification on a statistically meaningful sample: IRS transcripts (Form 4506-C), payroll or bank-deposit verification, with pool income growth compared with local IRS SOI zip-code income and BLS wages.
requests.format: Verification vendor results and sample design.
requests.why: Application income ran about 90% above IRS income in the worst zip codes, which defaulted most.
requests.pass: Verified income within tolerance; pool income growth not above local IRS and BLS growth.
requests.fail: Stated-income pools; income growth outrunning local IRS income.
requests.verify: IVES vendor engaged by us. Generic request also in universal U-FIN-016; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Re-mark of secured pools to current collateral value (not origination value), counting current LTV above 95% as distressed.
requests.why: Latent distress runs about 4 times reported delinquency.
requests.pass: Pricing reflects re-marked LTV and distressed count.
requests.fail: Pricing on origination values or payment status.

requests.request: Geography and foreclosure regime analysis for secured consumer and residential pools: recovery timing by judicial versus non-judicial state and local price pressure from clustered foreclosures.
requests.why: Judicial states take longer; clustered foreclosures depress prices.
requests.pass: Recovery timing modelled by state; clustering stressed.
requests.fail: Uniform recovery assumption.

requests.request: Bank extension history and payment-status-independent review for CRE notes bought from banks.
requests.why: Selling banks extend to delay loss recognition.
requests.pass: Every extension disclosed; priced on re-marked value.
requests.fail: Extensions hidden.

requests.request: Factoring receivable file: account debtor creditworthiness, dilution history, notification or non-notification, recourse or non-recourse, and for notification deals each account debtor's acknowledgment of assignment.
requests.format: Debtor credit reports, dilution reports, signed acknowledgments.
requests.why: First Brands: purported receivables sold to factors allegedly did not exist.
requests.pass: Every notification-deal debtor has acknowledged; dilution within reserve; debtors creditworthy.
requests.fail: Missing acknowledgments; rising dilution.
requests.verify: Confirm acknowledgments and invoices directly with debtors. Generic request also in universal U-COL-008; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Customer-side channel-stuffing test on the top account debtors: invoiced sales against each debtor's purchase, inventory or AP trend.
requests.why: Jumps in a debtor's inventory and AP signal pre-billing.
requests.pass: No divergence between invoiced sales and debtor trends.
requests.fail: Large unexplained jumps.

requests.request: Trade finance documents: bills of lading, warehouse receipts, letters of credit and invoices for each financed shipment, deduped across financiers, with counterparty and country risk assessment.
requests.why: The same shipping documents can be financed by several banks.
requests.pass: Every document verified with the issuer or carrier and unique across financiers.
requests.fail: Duplicate or unverifiable documents.
requests.verify: Verify with carriers, warehouses and issuing banks.

requests.request: Equipment collateral: values, residual value support, lessee credit and lien perfection, with serial-number dedupe.
requests.format: Appraisals, lessee financials, UCC filings and titles.
requests.why: Residual and lien gaps drive equipment losses; residual norms remain a bible gap.
requests.pass: Lien perfected on every item; serial numbers unique; residuals supported by appraisal.
requests.fail: Unperfected liens or duplicate serials.

requests.request: Royalty title chain and payor statements for the royalty stream.
requests.format: Assignment documents and payor statements for 3 years.
requests.why: Without title, the royalty is not ours.
requests.pass: Clean title chain; statements tie to cash receipts.
requests.fail: Gaps in title; statements not matching cash.

requests.request: Litigation case files and an independent legal opinion on case merits from counsel not involved in the case, with defendant collectability evidence.
requests.format: Opinion addressed to us; defendant financial evidence.
requests.why: Funders relying on claimant counsel's view mis-price merits.
requests.pass: Opinion supports merits; defendant can pay the modelled award.
requests.fail: Opinion from involved counsel; uncollectable defendant.

requests.request: Mark-lag test for semi-liquid vehicles: the vehicle's marks against the same loans in other BDCs' schedules and against leveraged-loan indices over the last 8 quarters.
requests.why: Stale NAV lets redeemers exit above economic value at remaining holders' expense.
requests.pass: Marks track other holders and indices within tolerance with no persistent lag.
requests.fail: Persistent lag after market declines.

requests.request: Secondary liquidity profile: share of loans unrated and number of fund families holding each loan.
requests.why: About 80% of loans unrated and fewer than 20% held by 10+ families: forced sales mean fire-sale discounts.
requests.pass: Liquidity profile reflected in the redemption terms and stress.
requests.fail: Redemption terms assume market liquidity that does not exist.

requests.request: Software and AI-exposure concentration in the portfolio, with an ARR downside stress on software loans.
requests.format: Holdings by industry and stress output.
requests.why: About one-fifth of semi-liquid fund loans are to software firms exposed to 2026 AI repricing.
requests.pass: Concentration disclosed and downside losses within the vehicle's protection.
requests.fail: Concentration not stressed.

requests.request: As a lender or co-lender where the loan holder is a perpetual BDC: the holder's redemption pressure and its likely workout stance (sale, resistance to new money, PIK preference), reflected in intercreditor terms.
requests.format: Holder's latest flow data and intercreditor draft.
requests.why: A redemption-pressured holder is a different workout counterparty.
requests.pass: Intercreditor terms protect us against a forced seller or PIK-favouring holder.
requests.fail: No protection.

requests.request: Litigation funding regulatory and disclosure review: applicable state ethics rules on funder control, court disclosure orders (for example D. Del. standing orders), and consumer funding rules.
requests.why: No federal statute governs litigation funding; disclosure rules are spreading court by court.
requests.pass: Control rights and disclosure compliant in each forum.
requests.fail: Control rights that breach ethics rules.
requests.verify: Our counsel; verify current federal rulemaking status.

requests.request: Loan-tape audit tracing borrower-level payments to bank deposits.
requests.format: Report from an auditor engaged by us.
requests.why: Fake pools and Ponzi payments.
requests.pass: Sample traced with no exceptions above tolerance.
requests.fail: Exceptions indicating originator-funded payments.

requests.request: Collateral or portfolio audit, including file review of a loan sample against the tape.
requests.why: Altered loan descriptions to meet eligibility (Tricolor).
requests.pass: File data matches tape for the sample.
requests.fail: Altered or missing files.

requests.request: Servicer review and backup servicer readiness assessment.
requests.format: Report from a servicer review firm or the backup servicer.
requests.why: Servicer failure.
requests.pass: Backup servicer can step in within the agreed time.
requests.fail: Cold backup with no data mapping.

requests.request: Independent collateral agent or custodian report holding original titles and notes and performing the cross-facility dedupe.
requests.why: No single party sees all the collateral.
requests.pass: Custody of 100% of originals; zero duplicates.
requests.fail: Partial custody.

requests.request: Independent legal opinion on case merits (litigation finance).
requests.format: Opinion from counsel not involved in the case.
requests.why: Merits risk.
requests.pass: Opinion supports underwriting.
requests.fail: Adverse or qualified opinion.

requests.request: Rating agency report with the agency's stressed assumptions.
requests.why: The rating is less informative than the assumptions behind it.
requests.pass: Our stress at least as severe as the agency's; our tranche survives.
requests.fail: Rating relied on without reading assumptions.

requests.request: Statutory-accounting specialist review of insurer-affiliated capital (Schedule S, consolidated RBC).
requests.format: Specialist memo; regulator or rating analyst interview where possible.
requests.why: Shadow reinsurance hides leverage; consolidated RBC remains a bible gap.
requests.pass: Consolidated RBC computed and adequate.
requests.fail: Adequate only before consolidation.

requests.request: Bank-funding analyst review for deposit-funded lenders (IRRBB, LCR-style outflow test).
requests.why: SVB would have been flagged 10 quarters early by IRRBB.
requests.pass: Passes both tests.
requests.fail: Fails either test.

requests.request: Custodial agreement executed and custodian receipt for every original note and title at funding.
requests.why: Possession is what prevents double pledging.
requests.pass: Receipt covers 100% of funded loans.
requests.fail: Exceptions at funding.

requests.request: Segregated collection accounts under control agreements and an executed backup servicer agreement.
requests.format: Executed DACAs and backup servicer agreement.
requests.why: Commingling and servicer failure.
requests.pass: All collections into controlled accounts; backup servicer contracted.
requests.fail: Commingled accounts.

requests.request: Notification and acknowledgment of assignment from account debtors on notification structures.
requests.why: First Brands.
requests.pass: Acknowledgments from every account debtor.
requests.fail: Missing acknowledgments.

requests.request: Executed facility or purchase agreements with eligibility criteria, reporting covenants (monthly tape, static pool, dedupe certification), and margin-call mechanics as approved.
requests.why: Protections dropped at signing.
requests.pass: All approved terms present.
requests.fail: Weakened terms.

requests.request: Pre-funding dedupe certification by the independent agent covering the funded pool.
requests.format: Agent certificate dated within 2 business days of funding.
requests.why: Loans added between diligence and funding.
requests.pass: Zero duplicates in the funded pool.
requests.fail: Any duplicate.

requests.request: Executed financing-line amendments or confirmations showing current haircuts, triggers and renewal dates at closing.
requests.why: Funding terms can change before close.
requests.pass: Terms match the stress model.
requests.fail: Worse terms not modelled.

requests.request: Monthly loan-level tape and servicer report reconciled to collection-account bank statements and trustee or lender reports.
requests.why: Early detection of payment and reporting divergence.
requests.pass: Reconciles with no unexplained difference.
requests.fail: Unreconciled differences.
requests.verify: Direct bank feed and trustee reports.

requests.request: Monthly static-pool and roll-rate update by vintage.
requests.why: Vintage deterioration precedes losses.
requests.pass: Within underwriting curves.
requests.fail: Vintages above curves two months running.

requests.request: Quarterly independent dedupe re-run across all facilities and a quarterly UCC re-search.
requests.why: Double pledging can start after closing.
requests.pass: Zero duplicates; no new unexplained filings.
requests.fail: Any duplicate or new filing.
requests.verify: Agent and search provider. Generic request also in universal U-COL-009; this item sets the credit pass criteria.

requests.request: Quarterly liquidity coverage ratio and redemption queue report.
requests.why: Recurring 5% redemptions exhaust thin liquidity.
requests.pass: Coverage at or above cap; queue disclosed.
requests.fail: Coverage below cap; growing queue or repurchases payable.

requests.request: Annual statutory statements, Schedule S and consolidated RBC update for insurer-affiliated capital.
requests.why: Capital erosion through affiliated reinsurance.
requests.pass: Consolidated RBC adequate.
requests.fail: Decline below adequacy.

requests.request: Quarterly bank-like funding metrics: uninsured share, unrealized losses to equity, outflow coverage, limit-breach log.
requests.why: Runs build in public data first.
requests.pass: Within limits.
requests.fail: Deterioration.

requests.request: Litigation case status reports with duration against the model and IRR at 1.5x duration updated.
requests.why: Duration overruns erode IRR.
requests.pass: Within model.
requests.fail: Overruns not reflected.

requests.request: Loan-level eligibility test results: pass or fail on each eligibility criterion for every loan in the pool or borrowing base, run from the tape and source files.
requests.format: Workbook produced from the tape with criterion-by-criterion results.
requests.why: Tricolor altered loan descriptions so ineligible loans looked eligible.
requests.pass: 100% of financed loans pass every criterion when tested against source files on the audit sample.
requests.fail: Loans that pass on the tape but fail on source files.
requests.verify: Collateral auditor re-tests a sample against original files.

requests.request: Concentration report for the pool: by obligor, industry, geography, originator or dealer, and vintage.
requests.why: Concentration turns diversified credit into a few large bets; geographic clusters amplify foreclosure price pressure.
requests.pass: Concentrations within facility and investment limits; geographic clusters stressed.
requests.fail: Undisclosed concentration above limits.

requests.request: Servicer collection, charge-off, modification and repossession policies, with any changes in the last 3 years.
requests.why: Policy changes (longer charge-off timing, liberal modifications) make performance look better than it is.
requests.pass: Policies consistent across vintages, or static-pool data adjusted for changes.
requests.fail: Unannounced changes in charge-off or modification policy.

requests.request: Originator underwriting guidelines and documentation-type mix (full, low, stated) by vintage.
requests.why: Low-documentation loans near cutoffs showed lax screening when loans could be sold.
requests.pass: Low-doc share stable or falling; guidelines consistent with the tape.
requests.fail: Rising low-doc share in recent vintages.
requests.verify: Sample files reviewed by collateral auditor.

requests.request: Collateral file chain for each purchased loan: original note, mortgage or security instrument, allonges and the recorded assignment chain to the seller.
requests.format: File inventory from the custodian and recorded assignments.
requests.why: Without a clean chain of title the buyer cannot enforce the note.
requests.pass: Complete chain for every loan; assignments recorded.
requests.fail: Missing allonges or unrecorded assignments.
requests.verify: County records and custodian exceptions report.

requests.request: ABS trustee and servicer reports for the last 24 months for every deal the originator has issued.
requests.why: Trustee reports are the independent record that the static pool must reconcile to.
requests.pass: Reports reconcile to static-pool data; no trigger breaches undisclosed.
requests.fail: Differences between trustee and servicer figures.

requests.request: CLO trustee reports for 24 months: OC and IC test results, CCC bucket, defaults, and trading activity.
requests.why: Coverage tests and trading show how the manager handles stress.
requests.pass: Tests passed with cushion; trading consistent with stated strategy.
requests.fail: Persistent test failures or distressed-exchange activity.

requests.request: CLO warehouse agreement: first-loss provider, warehouse lender, mark-to-market and termination terms, and manager economics during the warehouse.
requests.why: Warehouse risk and manager incentives drove the CDO machine.
requests.pass: Warehouse first-loss and termination risk allocated and disclosed; manager incentives aligned.
requests.fail: Equity investors bear undisclosed warehouse losses.

requests.request: LME map for distressed positions: which creditors can be primed or stripped under the existing documents (drop-down capacity into unrestricted subsidiaries and non-guarantors, uptier voting thresholds, pro rata amendment rights), and which holders could form a majority.
requests.why: LMEs move value from non-participants; the fulcrum must be priced after the LME.
requests.pass: Worst-case LME quantified and reflected in price.
requests.fail: Pricing before LME analysis.

requests.request: Recovery and liquidation analysis for distressed positions: collateral valuation, liquidation value, recovery waterfall after the worst LME.
requests.why: Historical recoveries (loans 84%, secured bonds 60%, senior unsecured 38%) are expected lower next cycle.
requests.pass: Recovery supports the price using Moody's URD base rates haircut for covenant-lite and thin junior cushions.
requests.fail: Recovery at historical averages without haircut.

requests.request: Litigation portfolio schedule: every case with committed and deployed capital, capital reserved to completion, diversification by defendant, forum and case type, and cross-collateralization terms.
requests.why: Funders without capital to see cases through lose their position; concentrated portfolios fail together.
requests.pass: Capital reserved covers each case to completion; no defendant or case above the concentration limit; cross-collateralization documented.
requests.fail: Under-reserved cases; concentration in one defendant.
requests.verify: Tie deployed capital to bank records.

requests.request: Executed litigation funding agreements showing non-recourse to the claimant, funder control rights, and termination provisions.
requests.why: Recourse or control terms can breach state ethics rules and void the agreement.
requests.pass: Non-recourse; control rights compliant with applicable ethics rules.
requests.fail: Recourse provisions or funder control of settlement.

requests.request: Trade finance counterparty and country risk assessment for each buyer, seller and issuing bank.
requests.why: Trade losses come from counterparty and country events as well as fraud.
requests.pass: Counterparties and countries within limits.
requests.fail: Concentration in weak counterparties or sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions.

requests.request: Semi-liquid vehicle gate, suspension, in-kind and queue provisions, quoted from the offering documents.
requests.why: Gates recur and carry stigma; suspensions only pause the run.
requests.pass: Provisions read and assumed to be used; in-kind and queue terms understood.
requests.fail: Provisions that allow indefinite suspension without disclosure.

requests.request: Semi-liquid fund-level leverage stack and its response to outflows: facilities, margin triggers, and net debt issuance against net outflows for 12 quarters.
requests.why: Net debt issuance rises 0.38 points of TNA per 1 point of net outflows.
requests.pass: Leverage not used to fund redemptions; margin triggers survivable in the stress.
requests.fail: Leverage rising with outflows.

requests.request: Affiliated-transaction policy for insurer capital: who approves the insurer buying the affiliated manager's loans, and the independent valuation and NAIC designation source (including private letter ratings) for each affiliated private placement.
requests.format: Policy, approval minutes, valuation reports and designation evidence.
requests.why: The manager is lending policyholders' money into its own deals.
requests.pass: Independent approval; every affiliated placement independently valued; designation sources identified.
requests.fail: Manager-only approval; affiliated placements valued by the manager.
requests.verify: Obtain from the valuation provider and rating agency directly.

requests.request: Cash collateral reinvestment schedule and collateral-posting triggers (rating downgrade, mark-to-market) for insurers, lenders and funds.
requests.why: AIG's reinvested securities-lending collateral and CDS posting triggers drained liquidity.
requests.pass: Collateral reinvested in liquid, short instruments; triggers modelled and covered.
requests.fail: Collateral in illiquid credit; uncovered downgrade triggers.

requests.request: Risk governance record for bank-like lenders: the limit-breach log and the record of limit changes for the last 24 months, the CRO's reporting line, and CRO changes.
requests.format: Logs and board risk committee minutes.
requests.why: Lehman raised limits to fit positions and replaced its CRO with a dealmaker.
requests.pass: No limits raised to accommodate positions; CRO independent and reporting to the board.
requests.fail: Limits raised after breaches; recent CRO replacement by a business head.
requests.verify: Board minutes; regulator correspondence where available.

requests.request: Token redemption, oracle and NAV rules: redemption timing and gates, the oracle or NAV source and update frequency, and how they match the underlying asset's liquidity.
requests.why: A token's trading speed should match the speed at which the underlying asset can honor redemptions.
requests.pass: Redemption terms no faster than underlying liquidity; NAV source independent.
requests.fail: Instant redemption against illiquid loans; manager-controlled oracle.
requests.verify: Independent review of the contract and oracle.

requests.request: Monthly structure trigger report: OC, IC, delinquency and loss triggers, and cash diversion events.
requests.why: Triggers protect senior tranches only if monitored.
requests.pass: All triggers passing or breaches handled per the waterfall.
requests.fail: Unreported breaches.

requests.request: Annual backup servicer readiness test and data-mapping refresh.
requests.why: A cold backup servicer cannot step in when needed.
requests.pass: Test passed; data mapped within the agreed transfer time.
requests.fail: Test failed or not performed.

requests.request: Monthly eligibility exception and repurchase report: loans found ineligible after funding and their repurchase or removal.
requests.why: Ineligible loans in the pool are where altered data shows up.
requests.pass: Exceptions below tolerance and cured within the agreement's period.
requests.fail: Rising exceptions or unpaid repurchases.

requests.request: Account debtor list with independently sourced contact details for direct verification of a receivables sample.
requests.why: Confirmations routed through the borrower can be faked.
requests.pass: Contact details confirmed independently of the borrower for every sampled debtor.
requests.fail: Contacts supplied only by the borrower.

kill_tests.test: Loan-level payments cannot be traced to bank deposits from borrowers, or are traced to originator or affiliate accounts.
Originator refuses a cross-facility dedupe or custodial possession of original titles and notes.
Charged-off loans appear as current in lender or trustee reports.
Unencumbered liquidity does not cover the margin call under stressed haircuts plus a 20% to 30% collateral decline.
Redemption cap exceeds liquidity coverage with no gate or in-kind provision.
Unrealized securities losses exceed equity at a deposit-funded lender with a large uninsured funding share.
Account debtors on a notification deal refuse acknowledgment or deny invoices.
Token conveys no enforceable claim on the underlying loans or the custodian is not bankruptcy remote.

red_flags.flag: No independent audit of the loan tape or collateral.
red_flags.check: Engage a loan-tape and collateral auditor.

red_flags.flag: Collateral pledged without custodial possession of titles or notes.
'Few defaults' with no delinquency roll or static-pool data.
red_flags.check: Demand roll rates and static pool.

red_flags.flag: Labels ('alternative assets', 'multi-strategy income') that hide private-loan exposure.
red_flags.check: Look through to holdings and how marks are set.

red_flags.flag: Lender leverage stack (subscription line, NAV facility, asset-based facility, repo) with no disclosed margin-call triggers.
Redemption-funded vehicle whose redemption cap exceeds its liquidity coverage.
red_flags.check: Compute cash + NII + maturities against the cap.

red_flags.flag: Insurer-affiliated platform lending policyholder money into its own deals with no independent valuation of affiliated placements.
Bank lending to the vehicle growing quickly with renewal concentrated in one period.
Fund leverage rising as net outflows rise, or growing repurchases payable.
Marks lagging other BDCs and leveraged-loan indices after a market decline.
Gate, suspension or in-kind provisions the manager says it will 'never use'.
Sponsor support (insiders buying in) presented as a liquidity backstop.
red_flags.check: Treat as discretionary; exclude from coverage.

red_flags.flag: Consolidated RBC much lower than reported once affiliated captives are included.
Cash collateral reinvested in credit, or rating-downgrade collateral-posting triggers.
Lender lacks collateral pre-positioned at the Fed.
Token redeemable faster than the underlying assets can pay.
red_flags.check: Match redemption terms to asset liquidity.

red_flags.flag: CLO with obligor limits above 2% or industry above 15%.
Distressed fulcrum priced before considering LMEs the documents allow.
Litigation funder control rights inconsistent with state ethics rules.

third_party_reports.required_when: Any pool, tape or loan portfolio
Any secured pool or receivables facility

third_party_reports.provider: Servicer review firm or backup servicer

third_party_reports.required_when: Any collateral financed by more than one facility; all consumer and auto paper

Independent valuation with direct engagement and confirmation call
Statutory accounting review (Schedule S, consolidated RBC)

hard_questions.question: Show me the loan tape at loan level, and the bank deposits behind its payment history.
hard_questions.good_answer: Immediate tape access and bank-issued collection statements with a prepared trace.

hard_questions.question: Who holds the original titles and notes? Who has run a collateral dedupe across every facility, and when?
hard_questions.good_answer: An independent custodian with receipts and a recent independent dedupe with zero duplicates.

hard_questions.question: Plot defaults around every eligibility cutoff. Is there a bunch or a jump?
How was borrower income verified, and on what sample?
hard_questions.good_answer: IRS transcripts or bank deposits on a statistically meaningful sample, with results.

hard_questions.question: What is the static-pool charge-off history by vintage, reconciled from the servicing system to trustee reports?
hard_questions.good_answer: Full vintage tables with a zero-difference reconciliation.

hard_questions.question: List every financing line with its haircut or advance rate, margin-call mechanics and term. What happens if haircuts go to 50%?
hard_questions.good_answer: A complete schedule and a modelled 50% case covered by unencumbered liquidity.

hard_questions.question: What unencumbered liquidity covers a margin call?
hard_questions.good_answer: A specific amount held at a custodian, sized to the stressed call.

hard_questions.question: Who values the Level 3 loans, and who has write access to the pricing inputs? Show me the same loans' marks in other managers' books.
hard_questions.good_answer: An independent agent, inputs controlled outside the deal team, and marks consistent with other holders.

hard_questions.question: Which default definition does your track record use? What were realized losses?
hard_questions.good_answer: Definition stated with realized losses reconciled to audited financials.

hard_questions.question: What is the redemption cap against cash, NII and maturities per quarter? What did you do the last time requests exceeded the cap?
hard_questions.good_answer: Coverage at or above the cap and a documented, fair response to past excess requests.

hard_questions.question: For a CLO: what is the AAA break-even default rate at 40% recovery? What are the obligor and industry limits? What is your after-fee PME by vintage?
hard_questions.good_answer: About 60% break-even, 2% obligor and 15% industry limits, and after-fee PME by vintage.

hard_questions.question: For insurer-affiliated capital: show the statutory statements, Schedule S and consolidated RBC including affiliated captives. Who values the affiliated private placements, and who rated them?
hard_questions.good_answer: Filings produced; consolidated RBC adequate; independent valuation and recognized ratings.

hard_questions.question: For a deposit-funded lender: what share of funding is uninsured, what is the unrealized loss to equity, and what is the 30-day outflow coverage?
hard_questions.good_answer: Low uninsured share, unrealized loss well below equity, outflow covered with pre-positioned collateral.

hard_questions.question: For litigation finance: what is IRR at 1.5x the expected duration, and can the defendant pay?
hard_questions.good_answer: IRR above hurdle at 1.5x and evidence of defendant capacity.

hard_questions.question: What are your warehouse lines and redemptions doing in the month your losses peak?
hard_questions.good_answer: A combined stress showing funding survives peak losses.

hard_questions.question: Which creditors can prime or strip us under the existing documents, and where is the fulcrum after that?
hard_questions.good_answer: A document-based LME map and post-LME fulcrum.

hard_questions.question: What legal right does the token give me to the underlying loan, and how fast can the underlying assets honor redemptions?
hard_questions.good_answer: A counsel opinion on the claim and redemption terms matched to asset liquidity.

failure_cases.case: The Adam brothers (a lending pool that did not exist)
failure_cases.what_happened: Promised up to 13.5% monthly from a 'lending pool'.
failure_cases.check: Independent verification that loan assets exist; proof of cash; the guaranteed-return red flag.

failure_cases.year: Collapsed Sept 2025; DOJ Dec 2025; SEC Aug 18 2026
failure_cases.what_happened: Alleged double-pledging of auto loans to multiple warehouse lenders and ABS deals, altered loan descriptions to meet eligibility, and charged-off loans booked as current in a fictitious portfolio company; a '$1.9 billion collapse'; ~40% of ~70,000 loans shared VINs or attributes.
failure_cases.check: VIN-level dedupe across all facilities by an independent agent; custodial possession of originals; static-pool charge-off reconciliation to trustee reports; verify each pledged receivable.

failure_cases.what_happened: Purported receivables sold to factors allegedly did not exist; collateral double- and triple-pledged.
failure_cases.check: Confirm receivables with the account debtor; notification and acknowledgment of assignment; dedupe against other factors.

failure_cases.case: First Liberty Building & Loan (bridge-loan pool Ponzi)
failure_cases.what_happened: $140M of notes promising up to 18% with 'few defaults'; most loans defaulted; new money paid old investors.
failure_cases.check: Loan-tape audit traced to bank deposits; delinquency roll behind any 'few defaults' claim.

failure_cases.what_happened: 94% uninsured deposits; $17B unrealized loss vs $15B equity in public filings; $42B one-day run.
failure_cases.check: Uninsured-funding share, unrealized loss to equity, IRRBB and a 30-day outflow test.

failure_cases.what_happened: Client outflows; shares -24% in a day; CDS > 1,000 bp; CHF 48B standing and CHF 120B emergency facilities before UBS takeover.
failure_cases.check: Watch CDS, outflows and shareholder support; keep a plan to move assets and novate trades.

failure_cases.case: Reserve Primary Fund ('cash' that was credit)
failure_cases.what_happened: $62.5B fund with $785M of Lehman paper got $40B+ of redemptions in two days, broke the buck and suspended; 99.1 cents final in 2014.
failure_cases.check: Look through 'cash' vehicles; model a 6 to 24 month gate.

failure_cases.what_happened: Reinvested securities-lending cash in RMBS; Fed lent up to $37.8B; CDS collateral calls drained liquidity; Maiden Lane III.
failure_cases.check: What is cash collateral invested in, and what collateral-posting triggers exist?

failure_cases.what_happened: AAA CDO tranches lost $325B; AAA CLO tranches lost nothing.
failure_cases.check: Test collateral, obligor and industry limits and AAA break-even for the specific vehicle.

failure_cases.what_happened: Stale marks, a 5% gate and thin cash produced gating, rising leverage and deferred payments; first aggregate net outflow; $10.7B unmet.
failure_cases.check: Liquidity coverage ratio, mark-lag tests, redemption queue history.

failure_cases.what_happened: Valuation presented as independent could not be evidenced.
failure_cases.check: Direct engagement letter with the valuation firm and a call to confirm it did the work.

failure_cases.what_happened: Raised limits to fit positions and replaced its CRO with a dealmaker in October 2007.
failure_cases.check: 24-month limit-breach log and limit changes; CRO independence.

failure_cases.what_happened: Lost ~$10B in a day and lacked collateral pre-positioned at the Fed.

failure_cases.case: Fake or over-pledged collateral (crypto 'market maker loan and dump' analog)
failure_cases.what_happened: Loans secured by assets that do not exist or are pledged elsewhere.
failure_cases.check: Independent verification of what secures the loan.

failure_cases.what_happened: Specialty finance collections commingled with the servicer's cash.
failure_cases.check: Backup servicer and segregated collection accounts.

failure_cases.what_happened: Loans bunched just above FICO 620 where securitization was easier and defaulted more.
failure_cases.check: Plot the tape around every cutoff.

failure_cases.what_happened: Warehouse haircuts rise, lines are pulled, or redemptions exceed liquidity when losses peak.
failure_cases.check: Funding stress with haircuts and redemptions at peak loss.

failure_cases.case: Forbearance and stale marks hiding losses
failure_cases.what_happened: Amend-and-extend and model marks keep losses off the books.
failure_cases.check: Amendment history and cross-BDC mark comparison.
